name: What materials are commonly used for kitchen backsplashes?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for kitchen backsplashes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common backsplash materials include ceramic and porcelain tile, natural stone (like marble, granite, or travertine), glass tiles, stainless steel, and sometimes even wallpaper or paint with a protective coating. Each material offers different aesthetic qualities, durability, and maintenance requirements, allowing for a wide range of design choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common backsplash materials are ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, glass, and stainless steel.
